Daily Text

Sunday, August 2, 2026

Tenth Sunday after Pentecost

Watchword for the week — The LORD is good to all, and his compassion is over all that he has made. Psalm 145:9

Sunday, August 2 — Isaiah 55:1-5; Psalm 145:8-9,14-21
Romans 9:1-5; Matthew 14:13-21

Although these nations that you are about to dispossess do give heed to soothsayers and diviners, as for you, the LORD your God does not permit you to do so. Deuteronomy 18:14

Now, however, that you have come to know God, or rather to be known by God, how can you turn back again to the weak and beggarly elemental principles? How can you want to be enslaved to them again? Galatians 4:9

Lord, as foreigners in a strange land, remind us to be mindful of the familiar temptations to serve the gods of false strength, security, and familiarity. Instead, help us follow your generous and compassionate leading. Amen.
